name: CurlShot (Remote)
description: Take screenshots of public web pages as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF through CurlShot's hosted MCP server, with full-page capture, device presets, dark mode, CSS selector capture and ad/cookie-banner blocking.

inputs.label: CurlShot API Key
inputs.description: API key sent as a Bearer token. Required by the take_screenshot tool; list_devices works without it.

obtain.instructions:
1. Create an account at curlshot.com/register (free plan, 100 screenshots/month, no card)
2. Open the dashboard
3. Copy your API key

auth.instructions: Create a free account at https://curlshot.com/register and copy your API key from the dashboard. It is sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.
